rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call is to abandon idols, polytheism, and division, enter Islam through tawhid, and establish the religion rightly.
rows.anchor: o senin kendilerini davet edip durduğun şey o putlardan o şirk ve tefrikadan vazgeçip tevhid ile İslâm’a girmek, dini doğrultmak işi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God selects whom He wills for His religion or for Himself.
rows.anchor: Allah ona: dinine veya kendisine dilediğini seçer, derer

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God grants success to whoever turns to Him and brings that person onto the right path.
rows.anchor: ve kim gönül verirse ona onu muvaffak kılar o doğru

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Division includes opposition to the prophets and later communities splitting the religion and fighting among themselves.
rows.anchor: gerek peygamberlere karşı ayrı baş tutarak muhalefet etmeleri, gerekse onların arkasından ümmetlerinin dinde tefrika çıkararak birbirleriyle uğraşmaları

words: إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People divided only after prophetic teaching gave them knowledge that division was harmful and ended badly.
rows.anchor: ancak kendilerine ilim geldikten sonra tefrikanın muzır ve âkıbeti fena olduğu peygamberlerin tebliğiyle

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their mutual transgression arose from envy, jealousy, worldly greed, wrongful demands, and excessive passions.
rows.anchor: Kıskançlık, çekememezlik dünya hırsı ile haksız istekler, aşırı sevdâlar yüzünden.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge by itself is insufficient to set people right.
rows.anchor: Demek ki ilim insanların salâhı için kâfi değildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The commanding self has corrupt feelings that can openly drive people to do what they know is wrong.
rows.anchor: Nefs-i emmârenin öyle kötü hissiyâtı vardır ki insanları bildiklerinin hilâfına açık açık fenalıklara sevkeder

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moral reform therefore needs practical training to discipline feelings as well as knowledge; religious education has special importance in this respect.
rows.anchor: ahlâk-ı beşerin ıslâhı işinde ilimden başka hissiyâtın tehzîbi için bir terbiye-i ameliye dahi lâzımdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord had already decreed a time for punishment, so the immediate punishment of those who divided was deferred.
rows.anchor: azab için ezelde bir vakt ü saat takdir edilmiş bulunmasa idi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without the appointed delay, judgment and punishment would have come as soon as they divided; it is deferred to the Day of Judgment, as Qamar 54:46 says.
rows.anchor: o icrâyı muayyen bir müddet ile cezâ gününe tehir eylemiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who inherited scripture after the prophets are the People of the Book living in the Muhammadan age.
rows.anchor: o peygamberlerin arkasından kitaba vâris kılınan, yani şimdi asr-ı Muhammedîde bulunan ehl-i kitab da

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The People of the Book are unsettled in doubt about their own scriptures.
rows.anchor: kitaplarından muhakkak bir şek içinde muztarip bulunuyorlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the command is to establish religion while people are caught in transgression, division, doubt, and confusion, Muhammad is to call them to the true religion.
rows.anchor: hâl de böyle bağy ü tefrika şekk ü ıztırab içinde olduğundan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is to call people to the true religion of tawhid and Islam.
rows.anchor: sen hemen davet et o doğru dine, tevhid ve İslâm dinine çağır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He is to remain upright and proceed straight as commanded.
rows.anchor: ve emrolunduğun gibi doğruluk et, doğru git

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He must not follow the false desires of either the polytheists or the People of the Book; following whims bends religion and causes division.
rows.anchor: hevâlarına uyma onların muhtelif, hakka muhalif bâtıl arzularına tâbi‘olma

words: ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad affirms faith in every book God sent, believing in none selectively and remaining free of doubt.
rows.anchor: bazısına inanıp da bazısına inanmamazlık etmem ve şek üzere değilim

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He is commanded to convey and apply God's law justly, replacing unjust rules of polytheism and transgression with God's judgment.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın ahkâm ve şeriatını adalet ile tebliğ ve icrâ eyleyeyim

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A foremost expression of establishing religion is removing unjust rulings and administering justice, which comes through affirming God's oneness and adhering rightly to His religion.
rows.anchor: dini doğrultmanın en mühim tezâhürâtından birisi zulüm hükümlerini kaldırıp adalet yapmaktır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is everyone's Lord, Creator, Judge, and patron.
rows.anchor: Allah bizim de Rabbimiz sizin de Rabbiniz hepimizin hâlıkımız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each party answers for its own deeds and receives its own reward or punishment.
rows.anchor: iyiliğinden kötülüğünden siz mes’ul olmazsınız, karşılığında sevâbı veya ikābı bize aittir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no need for further dispute with the People of the Book because the exposition and proof have made the truth clear.
rows.anchor: Sizinle bizim aramızda hüccet yok husûmet ve ihticâca mahal yok ey ehl-i kitab! Çünkü bu beyan ve isbat ile hak zâhir olmuş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will gather everyone on the Day of Judgment and decide their case; all ultimately return to Him to account, whatever they worship or pursue.
rows.anchor: Allah aramızı cem‘edecek yevmü’l-cem‘olan kıyamet günü hepimizi bir araya toplayıp hükmünü verecek

words: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who dispute about God or His religion after people have accepted all revealed books and followed the command to uprightness are disputing after the call has been answered.
rows.anchor: Ona icâbet olunduktan sonra, yani Allah’a icâbet olunduktan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their case has no theoretical, practical, transmitted, or rational foothold; arguing against evident truth and uprightness is simply a declaration of injustice.
rows.anchor: Ne nazarî ne amelî, ne naklî ne aklî hiçbir tutamakları kalmaz.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Besides their arguments being void, they incur God's wrath and a severe punishment.
rows.anchor: hem de haklarında şedîd bir azab vardır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God may destroy the ships with their occupants because of their sins, or destroy the ships and their property; He can sink and break them with a violent storm rather than stilling the wind.
rows.anchor: veya mallarıyla birlikte o gemileri telef eder, rüzgârı durdurmaz, lâkin şiddetli fırtına vererek batırır, parçalar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even so, God forgives many and saves them without sinking the ships.
rows.anchor: bununla beraber birçoğundan da affeder.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These events also make those who dispute God's signs understand that they have no escape; deliverance comes by submitting to the signs and acting within their guidance.
rows.anchor: kendilerine kaçamak, kurtuluş yoktur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever people receive in this life is only a temporary worldly enjoyment.
rows.anchor: Bütün bunlardan anlaşılır ki şimdi size verilmiş bulunan şeyler her ne olursa olsun

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is with God is better, pure benefit without evil mixed in, and everlasting.
rows.anchor: hem daha hayırlı hem daha bekālıdır hem şer karışığı olmaksızın hâlis hayr u menfaattir, hem de devamlı ebedîdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This lasting good is for believers who entrust their affairs to their Lord, trust His power, promises, and warnings, perform their duties, and seek His pleasure.
rows.anchor: ancak O’na tefvîz-i umûr ederler ve O’nun kudretine

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ali
rows.claim: Ali relates that Abu Bakr gave away all his wealth and was reproached by some people; this verse was revealed on that occasion.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ali’den rivayet olunur ki Hazret-i Ebû Bekir malının hepsini tasadduk etmiş, birtakım kimseler onu levm eylemişlerdi. Bu âyet o sebeple nâzil oldu.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith and reliance are two foundational qualities for religion and success in the spirit of both individuals and communities.
rows.anchor: gerek bir ferdin ve gerek bir cemaatin rûhunda dinin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Major sins are those attached to a warning of punishment, requiring a fixed penalty, or explicitly forbidden.
rows.anchor: “Kebâir” üzerine va‘îd terettüb eden veya haddi îcab eyleyen

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Indecencies are especially blatant and extreme forms of ugliness among such sins.
rows.anchor: “fevâhiş” de onların içinde bilhassa çirkinliği açık ve aşırı olan günahlar, fuhşiyyât.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgiving faults while angry is rare and noble; the restrictive pronoun says that this quality especially befits them, earning the praise of Q 3:134 for restraining anger and pardoning people.
rows.anchor: Burada لَهُم zamiri kasr ifade eder. Bu kasrın da vechi şudur: Gazab hâlinde kusur ve günah affedebilmek gayet nadir vâki‘olan yüksek bir ahlâktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They answer the Prophet's call to faith and obedience, like the Companions' pledge and response.
rows.anchor: Allah’a iman ve itaat için Peygamber tarafından yapılan davete ashâb-ı kirâmın bey‘at ve icâbetleri gibi bey‘at ve dinin direği olan namazı ikāme ile cemaat

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing prayer, the pillar of religion, helps keep the community cohesive and organized.
rows.anchor: dinin direği olan namazı ikāme ile cemaat ve cem‘iyyeti sağlam tutanlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their affairs are handled through consultation and soliciting one another's views, not despotism; they govern their own affairs rather than being captive to others.
rows.anchor: İşleri: buyurukları istibdad ile değil, aralarında danışıkla, re’ylerine müracaat iledir. Kendi işlerine kendileri sâhiptir, başkalarının elinde esir değil

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Consultation should gather people capable of reasoned judgment who can represent the general public's views for discussion.
rows.anchor: re’y kābiliyeti olan âmmenin re’ylerini temsil edebilecek ictihad sâhibi hall ü akd erbâbının toplanıp müzakere etmesiyledir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet consulted about the public interest in warfare as directed by Q 3:159; after him the Companions consulted on succession, fighting apostates, inheritance, penalties for wine drinking, and conquered Iraqi land.
rows.anchor: Resûl-i Ekrem sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ [Âl-i İmrân 3/159] müeddâsınca harp maslahatlarına ta‘alluk eden işlerde müşavere ederdi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Legal consultation concerns matters without a known decisive text, involving some scope for ijtihad or application that requires deliberation.
rows.anchor: olmayıp az çok mevrid-i ictihad olan veya tatbîkātı mücahedeye mütevakkıf bulunan husûsâttadır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Consultations form the basis of matters settled by consensus.
rows.anchor: Şûrâ müzakereleri icmâ‘î meselelerin aslını teşkil eder.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the Companions' era, Islamic history and legal theory did not develop the principle of consultation in proportion to the importance the Qur'an gives it.
rows.anchor: bu şûrâ düstûru devr-i sahâbeden sonra Kur’ân’ın verdiği bu ehemmiyet ile mütenâsib bir surette inkişaf ettirilememiştir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shura is a verbal noun meaning reciprocal consultation or taking one another's opinions; its root is associated with extracting honey from a bee, and it can also name the consultative body.
rows.anchor: “Şûrâ” esasen “fütyâ” gibi “büşrâ” vezninde masdar olup teşavür, yani birbirinin re’yini almak demektir. Aslı arıdan bal almak mânasıyla alâkadardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shura can also mean the people who deliberate and, by extension, a consultative council.
rows.anchor: Zû-şûrâ mânasına da gelir, nitekim bu mâna ile şûrâ heyetine de ıtlak olunur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their spending supplies the costs needed to carry out decisions made through consultation; this implies such expenditures should themselves be settled by consultation.
rows.anchor: bu infak şûrâ ile verilen kararın icrâsı için lâzım gelen masrafı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When their rights are violated, they aid one another, defend their rights, refuse humiliation, and punish the aggressor justly without excess or dependence on another nation; communal unity secures independence, honor, and victory.
rows.anchor: Haklarını müdafaa eder, haksızlığa boyun eğmez, zilleti hoşlanmaz, bağy ü tecavüz edenin cezâsını verirler, aşırı gitmeyerek adaletle öclerini alırlar ve bunun için başka bir milletin himâyesine sığınmazlar

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Some commentators restrict this oppression to an external attack, explaining the praise as applying when polytheists attack Muslims and the Muslims retaliate.
rows.anchor: bazıları bunu yalnız hâriçten vâki‘olan tecavüze mahsus zannetmişler de müşrik müslime tecavüz ettiği takdirde intikamını alanın medhiyle tefsir etmişlerdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The collective wording covers violations of both public and personal rights, whether internal or external; because each believer's rights are the community's responsibility, preventing and punishing violations is a communal duty, through just courts internally and political measures externally.
rows.anchor: her ferd-i mü’minin hukūku cemaatin taahhüdü altında bulunduğu cihetle

rows.speaker: ابن جرير الطبري
rows.claim: Ibn Jarir al-Tabari judges the broader second view more correct: since God did not restrict the meaning, He praises anyone who justly retaliates against an aggressor.
rows.anchor: İbn Cerîr Taberî tefsirinde der ki: “Bu ikinci kavil savâba evlâdır. Zira Cenâb-ı Allah bir mânayı tahsis buyurmamış

rows.speaker: ابن جرير الطبري
rows.claim: Tabari explains that justly giving an oppressor the punishment he deserves guides him toward the right, which is why retaliation can be praised.
rows.anchor: Denilir ki zâlime müstahik olduğu cezâyı vermekte onu hak yoluna doğrultmak, bunda ise en büyük medih vardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This trait applies the earlier command to justice and should be read with their forgiveness when angry; they can both pardon and retaliate while acting independently, without another community's influence.
rows.anchor: bu sıfat yukarıda وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ diye beyan buyurulan adalet emrinin tatbîki nokta-i nazarından gayet mühim olan yüksek bir ahlâkın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their forgiveness and retaliation alike are exercised through their own independence, without being controlled by another nation or community.
rows.anchor: ne aflarında ne de intikamlarında başka bir millet ve cemaatin tesirine mahkum olmazlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rule that a wrong is answered with its like is a universal foundation for penal law and, in general, criminal codes.
rows.anchor: Bu düstur Fıkıhta ukūbât ahkâmına

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For retaliation to count as punishment, it must be an act displeasing to the offender; otherwise it becomes a crime and injustice that encourages wrongdoing.
rows.anchor: cezâ olabilmek için onun gibi bir seyyie, yani mücrimin hoşuna gitmez bir fiil olmalıdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The penalty must equal the offense; exceeding it violates justice, so retaliation must stay within the bounds of the wrong.
rows.anchor: cezâ cürmün misli ve müsâvîsi olmalıdır, yoksa adalet olmaz.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever forgives the person who wronged them and repairs their hostile relationship will receive a great reward from God.
rows.anchor: kendine kötülük eden kimsenin suçunu affedip onunla arasındaki husûmet hâlini düzeltirse

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The singular form whoever pardons hints that pardon here concerns personal rights rather than public rights.
rows.anchor: “afv”ın müfred sîgasıyla îrâdı bunun

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God loves neither those who initiate oppression nor those who become unjust by exceeding the proper penalty.
rows.anchor: gerek ibtidâen bağy ü zulm edenleri, gerekse cezâda ileri gitmek suretiyle zulmedenleri, hiçbirini sevmez

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since exact equivalence is difficult in cases where injustice is likely, one who can punish but instead forgives and reconciles earns a great reward.
rows.anchor: Cezâda mümâselet ve müsâvâta riayet müşkil olan husûsâtta zulüm ihtimâli gālib olacağı için tecziyeye kādir olduğu hâlde af ile ıslah yapan kimselere Allah büyük ecir verir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person who retaliates after being wronged faces no penalty for doing so; forgiveness is better, but equal retaliation is permitted.
rows.anchor: Af evlâ olmakla beraber affetmeyip de mukābele bi’l-misl yapan ferdlere karşı cezâ için yol yoktur.

words: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Liability falls on those who initiate oppression or exceed the limits in retaliation and punishment.
rows.anchor: O yol ancak nâsa zulmedenlere ibtidâen zulmeyleyen veya mukabelede ileri giden, cezâda haddi aşanlara

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here forgiving means pardoning and concealing the wrong, while patience means reconciliation; both require endurance and are marks of people of high resolve.
rows.anchor: Buradaki “mağfiret”, yukarıda zikrolunan “afv”, “sabır” da ıslahtır. Buna “sabır” tâbir olunması af ve mağfiretin sabra mütevakkıf

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pardon merits praise when it comes from someone capable of retaliation; it signals strength rather than helplessness.
rows.anchor: afv ü setrin âcizlerden değil, gücü yetenlerden sâdır olmak şartıyla medh ü sitâyişe şâyan olduğunu anlatır
